execution_focus.policy: Only EVID-01 may expand repository scope. In parallel, TUI-01, TAR-05 and other declared production/external/governance units may complete safe auto_collect work; deployments, production writes, paid calls and human decisions still require their recorded authorization boundary.

workstreams.title: Evidence governance and decision hard gate
workstreams.next_gate: EVID-01 now has a repository-side immutable owner/tenant authority lifecycle, authenticated selector bridge and same-alias scope-source writer composition. Preserve the global execution deny; next deploy migration 0055 under authorization, collect a real independent root approval, then prove PostgreSQL first-winner/revocation/rollback and owner/reviewer sign-off. Never derive tenant/owner from mutable User/Profile/session state.

workstreams.title: Strategy research R1-R8 production closure
workstreams.next_gate: Register real owner definitions and canonical receipts, accumulate required PIT/OOS history, then obtain Promotion and consumer UAT evidence.

workstreams.title: Data Center canonical and production reliability closure
workstreams.next_gate: Complete production backup, controlled backfill, reconciliation, M9/M10 cutover and observation evidence on PostgreSQL.

workstreams.title: System audit event consolidation
workstreams.next_gate: Repository expansion is paused behind the EVID-01 execution focus; preserve the current fail-closed publisher and authority boundaries while collecting only read-only backlog and health evidence.

workstreams.title: Web to TUI M5 production closure
workstreams.next_gate: After TAR-03 exits and the release surface is frozen, bind one manifest-backed candidate from the canonical cutover evidence, run role-based browser UAT, and start the closing 14-day observation window; any earlier candidate window is non-closing soak evidence.

workstreams.title: Terminal Agent multi-user queue and hybrid runtime remediation
workstreams.next_gate: TAR-01 through TAR-04 repository contracts are complete. Freeze one immutable candidate and complete TUI-01 role UAT/write receipts plus TAR-05 provider, capacity, chaos, restore/rollback, telemetry and owner/reviewer production acceptance; queued/worker defaults remain fail-closed until those gates pass.

workstreams.title: AI-Native release acceptance
workstreams.next_gate: Bind staging and production browser UAT plus independent owner/reviewer approval to the same candidate commit and release manifest.

workstreams.title: QMT live trading bridge external acceptance
workstreams.next_gate: Obtain the target Windows XtQuant environment, run Phase 0 compatibility and continuous simulation, then complete controlled small-value live acceptance.

workstreams.title: TUI usability and metadata governance remediation
workstreams.next_gate: TUX-01 metadata-load fallback is complete; repository expansion is paused behind EVID-01. TUX-02/TUX-04 may resume only after the current repository focus advances and without disturbing the M5 candidate evidence line.

waves.title: Plan inventory closure
waves.rule: Dispose of the review queue without opening a new implementation line.

waves.title: Decision safety, audit and urgent runtime isolation
waves.rule: Run one major repository line at a time; EVID-01 is the current bounded P0 repository priority. TAR-01 through TAR-04 repository contracts are complete; declared production auto-collection continues in parallel without weakening Evidence or Audit gates.

waves.title: Production data and research acceptance
waves.rule: Do not start destructive cutover before backup, rollback and reconciliation evidence exist.

waves.title: Candidate release and user acceptance
waves.rule: Bind deployment, browser UAT, telemetry and sign-off to one immutable candidate.

waves.title: Externally unblocked broker acceptance
waves.rule: Start only after the broker supplies a working XtQuant environment and permission.

waves.title: TUI usability and metadata governance
waves.rule: Repository-only remediation bounded to the published TUI surface; it must not disturb the M5 candidate evidence line or expand into production cutover.

units.title: Dispose of the seven remaining time-bounded legacy plans
units.exit_gate: All seven remaining review items were archived or mapped to canonical workstreams on 2026-08-15; the review queue is empty and no new implementation line was opened.

units.title: Close owner-scoped Evidence authority and production composition
units.exit_gate: Exact user, tenant and owner authority is mandatory and fail-closed at every production Evidence read and approval composition boundary.

units.title: Prove append-only approval and current-head behavior on PostgreSQL
units.exit_gate: Human approval, first-winner, successor, current-head and rollback behavior have repeatable PostgreSQL concurrency evidence.

auto_collect: Run the PostgreSQL concurrency harness, capture first-winner/current-head results and hash the immutable report.
Query existing approval and successor ledgers read-only and report missing, duplicate or drifted heads.
authorization_required: Create or mutate production approval subjects, approvals or rollback records.
human_or_external_required: A real authorized reviewer makes the approval decision; automation may package but never invent that decision.

units.title: Wire priority adapters and exact pre-execution revalidation
units.exit_gate: Priority Research, Portfolio and Broker consumers use canonical Evidence and exact-current authorization without relaxing the global deny.

units.title: Assemble the canonical audit publisher, runtime and authority source
units.exit_gate: The fail-closed dispatcher uses one production publisher and authenticated scoped authority composition with no memory or generic-event fallback.

units.title: Wire Data Center fetch events in the same unit of work
units.exit_gate: Fetch, validation, failover, persistence and publication events use the canonical event/outbox transaction and can be replayed without silent loss.

units.title: Complete production audit migration and operational acceptance
units.exit_gate: Migration and rollback, backlog recovery observation, bounded metrics, alerts, admin TUI, archive/restore and production sign-off are evidenced.

auto_collect: Read migration state, outbox backlog/age, bounded metrics, alerts and admin TUI health from the deployed candidate.
Continuously derive recovery duration, duplicate/loss counts and archive integrity from raw production snapshots.
authorization_required: Run production migration, rollback, fault injection, archive or restore actions.
human_or_external_required: The production owner and reviewer sign the operational acceptance.

units.title: Freeze the multi-user runtime, queue and local-client contracts
units.exit_gate: The current inline baseline, ownership boundaries, state machine, API/SSE contracts, capacity limits, threat model, SLOs and deterministic test matrix are approved and protected by failing-first contract tests.

units.title: Build durable asynchronous admission and dispatch
units.exit_gate: Authenticated submissions atomically create idempotent PostgreSQL run records, enforce bounded per-user and global admission, publish only after commit, and return stable task, queue and retry semantics without invoking Agent work in the Web process.

units.title: Isolate Agent execution and deliver recoverable user events
units.exit_gate: A dedicated Agent worker claims runs idempotently, renews leases, reconciles crashes, supports cancellation, persists ordered events and serves resumable TUI/SDK status without sharing Web or Qlib execution capacity.

units.title: Create verified backup and rehearse maintenance rollback
units.exit_gate: A production custom-format backup is downloaded and hash-verified, and maintenance plus rollback procedures are rehearsed before destructive work.

auto_collect: Discover and download the latest existing production custom-format backup without changing remote state, verify remote/local SHA-256 and record age and manifest.
Restore a downloaded immutable dump into an isolated disposable database and derive schema/data comparison plus RTO evidence.
authorization_required: Create a new backup on the production host, prune remote backups, enter maintenance or exercise a live rollback.
human_or_external_required: The production owner selects the maintenance window and authorizes any live-state operation.

units.title: Run controlled backfill and canonical reconciliation
units.exit_gate: The production universe is backfilled with observation-time preservation and reconciled against canonical sources within governed tolerances.

auto_collect: Run read-only preflight, coverage, freshness, timestamp-preservation and cross-source reconciliation reports before and after each authorized batch.
Collect checkpoint progress, failed symbols, retry outcomes and canonical tolerance breaches from production telemetry.
authorization_required: Start, retry or alter a production backfill, delete/correct production rows or change governed tolerances.
human_or_external_required: A data owner approves any tolerance exception or source-quality waiver.

units.title: Execute M9/M10 cutover and observation
units.exit_gate: Canonical reads, readiness, smoke checks and the observation window pass before maintenance mode is removed.

auto_collect: Probe service and decision readiness separately, run read-only canonical smoke checks and track the immutable candidate throughout the observation window.
Derive freshness, reliability, must-not-use blockers, defect counts and observation duration from raw production responses.
authorization_required: Perform M9/M10 cutover, change maintenance mode, replace the production candidate or execute rollback.
human_or_external_required: The production and data owners approve removal of maintenance mode.

units.title: Register real R1-R8 owner definitions and policies
units.exit_gate: Canonical owner, definition, policy, calendar, scope, sample-window and qualification bindings exist for every promoted capability.

auto_collect: Inventory existing production owner/definition/policy/calendar/scope bindings and report exact missing or inconsistent fields.
Validate hashes, current-head identity and capability coverage without creating records.
authorization_required: Create or modify production definitions, policies, calendars, scopes or promotion bindings.
human_or_external_required: Named business owners supply and approve the authoritative policy and qualification values.

units.title: Accumulate PIT/OOS history and canonical receipts
units.exit_gate: Required PIT/OOS windows, receipts, lineage and reconciliation evidence are complete without fixture or synthetic substitution.

auto_collect: Continuously measure real PIT/OOS window coverage, receipt completeness, lineage continuity and reconciliation from production records.
Report elapsed sample history and the exact earliest eligible completion date without substituting fixtures or synthetic observations.
authorization_required: Run historical production backfill/rebuild or mutate canonical receipts.
human_or_external_required: A strategy owner approves any documented sample-window exception.

units.title: Complete Promotion and consumer UAT
units.exit_gate: Promotion, permission, consumer behavior and rollback UAT pass against the same canonical receipts and Evidence contracts.

auto_collect: Run candidate-bound permission, consumer, browser and rollback test journeys and bind reports to canonical receipt hashes.
Collect read-only promotion state, consumer outcomes and authorization blockers from production.
authorization_required: Promote or roll back a production capability or execute a UAT step that writes production state.
human_or_external_required: Business owners judge the real consumer outcome and sign UAT acceptance.

units.title: Deliver the server-side CLI/API and governed MCP client path
units.exit_gate: The server-side Agent Runtime owns provider credentials and Agent orchestration; a B/S or thin client uses scoped API/MCP tokens, preserves approval and audit controls, and passes server/API compatibility, disconnect and secret-leakage tests. User-side provider-backed Agent packaging is not part of the product.

units.title: Deploy one manifest-bound candidate and run role UAT
units.exit_gate: One immutable commit, version, OCI revision and matrix SHA is deployed and completes role-based browser UAT with write receipts.

auto_collect: Read and cross-check deployed commit, version, OCI revision, matrix, graph and runtime manifest identities.
Run candidate-bound read-only health/readiness probes and role browser journeys, then derive UAT coverage from raw reports.
authorization_required: Deploy or replace the production candidate and execute UAT mutations that create production write receipts.
human_or_external_required: Role owners confirm business outcomes that cannot be decided from deterministic assertions.

units.title: Complete observation, signed cleanup waves and rollback evidence
units.exit_gate: The 14-day telemetry window, registry backup, wave observation, rollback drill and owner/reviewer sign-off all bind to the candidate.

auto_collect: Calculate observation day, candidate drift and reset conditions; collect blocking-defect and 101-item telemetry snapshots and derive gate status.
Verify existing registry backup artifacts and run the candidate-bound isolated rollback drill without touching live state.
authorization_required: Create a production registry backup, execute cleanup waves, alter routes/assets or perform live rollback.
human_or_external_required: The owner and independent reviewer provide the two real sign-offs.

units.title: Complete AI-Native staging and production acceptance
units.exit_gate: Real staging and production browser evidence plus independent owner/reviewer approval bind to the same candidate commit.

auto_collect: Run browser journeys, capture raw results and screenshots, and verify candidate/manifest binding and result consistency.
Collect existing provider, runtime and audit outcomes without inventing model responses or acceptance.
authorization_required: Trigger billable external model calls or staging/production mutations outside an already authorized test run.
human_or_external_required: The owner and independent reviewer approve the real AI-Native task outcome.

units.title: Prove capacity, chaos recovery and production cutover
units.exit_gate: The immutable candidate passes 1/5/10/20-user load, fairness, duplicate, worker-crash, Redis outage, model-timeout, Web SLO, rollback and observation gates before inline retirement or any capacity increase.

auto_collect: Run approved staging load/soak suites and continuously collect latency, fairness, duplicate, queue, Web, Redis, DB, worker and model metrics into candidate-bound reports.
Derive observation and recovery outcomes from raw event timelines; unavailable metrics remain unavailable rather than becoming zero.
authorization_required: Generate production load, inject production faults, enable canary/queued intake, retire inline mode or increase capacity.
human_or_external_required: Operations and product owners approve the capacity envelope and production cutover.

units.title: Obtain XtQuant permission and pass Phase 0 on the target host
units.exit_gate: The broker supplies an approved XtQuant environment where the read probe and compatibility matrix pass.

auto_collect: Once an approved target environment is reachable, run the read-only XtQuant Phase 0 probe and build the compatibility report automatically.
human_or_external_required: The broker supplies XtQuant permission, target-host access and authoritative environment approval.

units.title: Complete continuous simulation and controlled small-value live acceptance
units.exit_gate: Order, cancel, callback, reconnect, reconciliation, emergency stop and rollback evidence pass before live enablement.

auto_collect: Collect simulation order/cancel/callback/reconnect timelines, reconciliation diffs and emergency-stop state from the approved environment.
Build candidate-bound reports from broker receipts without treating simulated or missing receipts as live evidence.
authorization_required: Submit or cancel any real order, enable live trading, change emergency-stop state or execute a live rollback.
human_or_external_required: The broker and business owner approve the controlled small-value live test and final enablement.

units.title: Add fail-safe fallback for invalid published TUI metadata
units.exit_gate: A deliberately invalid published payload degrades /tui/ to the file payload with a governance alert instead of a 500, and a batch revalidation command covers all stored registry records.

units.title: Consolidate the triple copy sources into the published flow
units.exit_gate: Dead Python screen patches are removed, the eight drifted dual-writes are reconciled, runtime screen copy moves under publish/review, and a machine check proves published JSON, IA registry and runtime loading agree.

units.title: Split auto-promoted actions and rewrite user-facing action copy
units.exit_gate: All 430 actions pass the copy machine check with no route keys, machine-translated fragments or boilerplate descriptions, and every screen is back within its action-density budget.

units.title: Restructure IA groups, disambiguate entries and complete runtime screen contracts
units.exit_gate: The research-tools catch-all group is reorganized, confusing entry pairs are renamed, terminology is unified, all 12 runtime screens carry full metadata contracts, and ordinary-role walkthrough hits no admin-only target.

units.title: Close layout, field-name translation and freshness-presentation defects
units.exit_gate: Browser evidence shows fixed table layout, translated field names, no internal screen keys, a working or removed status bar, and a recorded resolution of the freshness-presentation contradiction.
